# apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localization (Resource)

Sets the name a leaderboard has within a Game Center leaderboard set, for one locale. The leaderboard must be in the set; see `apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member`. Import it with `<leaderboard_set_id>/<leaderboard_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localization" "en_US" {
  leaderboard_set_id = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member.weekly.leaderboard_set_id
  leaderboard_id     = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member.weekly.leaderboard_id
  locale             = "en-US"
  name               = "This Week"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard, e.g. `apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member.example.leaderboard_id`.
- `leaderboard_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard set.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `name` (String) Name of the leaderboard within the set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    leaderboard_set_id = "6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f"
    leaderboard_id     = "4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c"
    locale             = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard.
- `leaderboard_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard set.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member_localization.en_US 6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f/4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c/en-US
```
